name: Offline
when: Lost the connection, or a service is down

variants.name: Unplugged
variants.desc: A plug dangles loose beside an empty socket.

variants.name: No signal
variants.desc: Looks up at a crossed-out wifi sign as the bars flicker.

variants.name: Cloud down
variants.desc: A crossed-out cloud drifts above it.

variants.name: Static
variants.desc: Flat eyes and a fuzz of static, like a lost channel.

variants.name: Broken link
variants.desc: Two chain links try to join, spark and bounce apart.
